task.objective:
Apply and repair the deployed-course sidebar save/sign-in behavior across active course sites, including the follow-up CALM and Sports Wellness regressions.

Goal:
- Standardize the Google-hosted save/sign-in control so deployed courses place it in the course sidebar, sticky at the visible bottom.
- Include sidebar shells that use `.sidebar`, Forensics shells, and `id="sidebar"`.
- Remove the Forensics 25 top bar that shows Next Step, module/content/quiz/assignment counts, and Student User.
- Fix CALM Module 2 so the save/sign-in control mounts inside the React sidebar instead of floating.
- Fix Sports Wellness so the save/sign-in control no longer breaks the responsive top/side bar.
- Fix CALM Module 3 so collapsed sidebar mode does not show stray save/sign-in UI.
- Re-export and deploy active course targets without overwriting the canonical Forensics 25 option2 site with the older source-only `forensics` project.

Evidence commands:
- focused Forensics 25 and Google-hosted bridge tests
- focused CALM and Sports Wellness sidebar-host tests
- typecheck and Studio build
- Google-hosted exports/deploys for active course sites
- live DOM checks and screenshots for deployed course URLs

Acceptance boundary:
Do not edit raw imports. Keep changes to active workspace files, shared Google-hosted bridge behavior, focused tests, generated hosted deploy files, and STAX report/task files.
